respuesta.pregunta: In vendor-stockkeeper-api 0.0.3-paused-seller, before sending a restock I need to check whether an item is a test item. What's the exact tag value I should look for in the item's tags?
respuesta.respuesta:
The docs don't agree on the exact tag value, so I can't tell you which spelling is right.

The guide says to identify test items by looking up the item in the item API and checking its tags [vendor-stockkeeper-api/0.0.3-paused-seller/guide/important.md:L128-L128]. After that, the two places that name the tag disagree:

- The text says to check that the item has **`test_items`** (plural) "or any of the tags" that mark an item as a test item [vendor-stockkeeper-api/0.0.3-paused-seller/guide/important.md:L231-L231].
- The example item-detail response on the same page shows the tag as **`test_item`** (singular) in the `tags` array [vendor-stockkeeper-api/0.0.3-paused-seller/guide/important.md:L199-L206].

So the documentation has a plural and a singular spelling for the same check, and it doesn't say which one the item API really returns. The text also mentions "any of the tags" that identify a test item but never lists them. To settle it, check the tags on a real item you know is a test item, or ask the team that owns the guide.
answer_checks: Cites the text that says to check for the tag test_items (important.md line 231).
Cites the example item response whose tags array contains test_item (around lines 199-206 of important.md).
Explains the plural vs. singular mismatch without stating either value as the confirmed correct tag.
Does not invent a list of other test-item tags beyond what the documents show.
